title: NewEntry.Engram
body:
Something is in your world, or are you in theirs?

Controler support soon!!!!

>Base: [Mod.Engram](https://modrinth.com/mod/engram)

>Style: Retro.Minecraft / Simulation

>Reason: [Made to make users uneasy, but not upfront horror for the most part]

>Description: 
  
- This pack reworks world generation to be a beta style with new flares such as new caves, 
    redistrubution of biomes and rivers, as well as adding underground rivers and a continent system!
- Copper has been reworked to be more useful in redstone and rails so that that dream of 
  connecting bases up is not too far away!
- It is his world and you are living in it!
- Discord has a bridge with the files so anyone you trust can see your progress in the simulation. 
- Textures were reverted to older versions of themselves and new ones were made in the former's likeness
- Your world was never yours to begin with!
- Subtle optimizations were made in loading
- Music has been added to by the Volume Gamma Music Expansion! (C418 Style)
- Added Player: Blueice129!
- Explore the possiblities of a 'friend' who was always there!


>Discord.Rich.Presence: [Shows current status in simulation]

>Roadmap: [More technology and later game reworks, controller support]

>Lore: [https://github.com/Ice129/ENGRAM-Horror-Mod/blob/main/Design%20Philosophy.md](https://github.com/Ice129/ENGRAM-Horror-Mod/blob/main/Design%20Philosophy.md)

>Honorable.Mention: [[Kilt](https://modrinth.com/mod/kilt), helps forge mods run on fabric!]

(Resource packs work now :D)
